WaterBro is created and operated in the United States by Valeriia Mudrak under the Valeriia Labs brand. By downloading or using WaterBro, you agree to these Terms and Apple’s applicable App Store terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

The service

WaterBro is a personal wellness app for recording water intake, viewing progress and history, setting a goal, building streaks, receiving optional reminders, and creating progress cards. You may use it worldwide for personal, lawful purposes.

Health disclaimer

WaterBro provides general wellness information only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Fluid needs vary. Follow a qualified clinician’s instructions if you have a medical condition, symptoms, or a fluid restriction.

Three-day preview and lifetime purchase

All WaterBro features are available for three days beginning with first launch. The preview ends without an automatic charge. Continued access after the preview requires an optional one-time lifetime in-app purchase.

The App Store shows the localized price and asks for confirmation before purchase. Apple processes payment, refunds, and purchase restoration. WaterBro does not receive your complete payment-card details. The lifetime purchase is not an auto-renewing subscription.

Your information and iCloud

Your entries and optional profile are stored locally and may synchronize through your private iCloud database. Synchronization depends on your Apple Account, network, settings, storage availability, and Apple’s services. WaterBro cannot guarantee uninterrupted synchronization or permanent preservation. Keep separate copies of any records you consider important.

You can delete data using the controls described in the Privacy Policy.

You must not misuse WaterBro, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, violate another person’s rights, or use shared content unlawfully. You are responsible for protecting access to your device and Apple Account and for the accuracy of information you enter.

Sharing and third-party services

You decide whether to share a progress card through Instagram or another destination. Third-party services and external websites are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
